Subject: Re: Redwood DPA + TOMs — TOMs exhibit edits (draft)

Tara / team — draft TOMs updates below (high level) and attached a tracked doc (TOMs_edits_v2.docx):

- Encryption at rest: require AES-256 for persisted customer data.
- CMK / Key custody: Redwood supports integrations with customer KMS providers (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS). For Private/on-prem customers we support HSM-backed key storage and BYOK workflows. Add clause: "Customer may provide and control encryption keys via [supported KMS]. Redwood will not access Customer-managed keys except to perform strictly necessary operational tasks with Customer authorization."
- Key rotation & escrow: recommend 90-day rotation window; Redwood will support automatic rotation workflows and can provide key escrow only via explicit written agreement.
- Access controls: RBAC for production clusters; developer access to key material is restricted and logged.
- Logging & audits: audit logs available for key operations and access events; SOC2 and audit evidence can be provided under NDA.

On subprocessors: Neha, please add the latest list and propose a clause that requires 30 days' notice for additions and an objection process for critical regulated data categories.

On e-sign: DocuSign is fine. We'll produce a two-signatory envelope (Acme sign → Redwood sign) and include the TOMs as an exhibit.

Marissa
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
